release_notes: HikMicro HM-TD8168-230ZK4FL is a thermal & optical bi-spectrum stable positioning (PTZ) camera pairing a 640x512 uncooled VOx thermal channel (NETD <= 25 mK, 15-230 mm) with a 4 MP optical channel (4 mm panoramic + PTZ zoom 10-1100 mm), 360 continuous pan, dynamic fire detection and -20 to 150 C temperature measurement.
